properties.title: Ruchenhüttli
properties.description: The Ruchenhüttli is situated in an idyllic spot in the Brunnital, surrounded by forests, steep rock faces and three-thousand-metre peaks. The hut has two rooms and can accommodate 14 people. Guests can cook using a wood-burning stove or a gas hob; it has running cold water, and a small power station supplies the necessary electricity.
